episodes.synopsis: After losing a school battle to his classmate Rantaro, Valt vows to work on his Blading fundamentals. His friend, Beyblade genius Shu, encourages him.
episodes.title: Let's Go! Valtryek!

episodes.synopsis: Valt is over the moon thanks to his tournament win, but Shu warns him that true greatness requires discipline. Rantaro challenges Valt to a rematch.
episodes.title: Kerbeus: Guard Dog of the Underworld!

episodes.synopsis: Valt's battle against Ken Midori continues, with advancement in the tournament on the line. Meanwhile, Shu and Daigo face their first opponents.
episodes.title: Blast Off! Rush Launch!

episodes.synopsis: After getting permission to start a Beyblade club at school, Valt has to get people to join. He and Rantaro battle to decide who will be club leader.
episodes.title: Beyblade Club: Let's Get Started!

episodes.synopsis: Claiming to be a fan of Valt's, Daigo challenges him to a friendly match that ends up not so friendly. Valt vows to practice his Rush Launch.
episodes.title: Into the Darkness! Dark Doomscizor!

episodes.synopsis: Valt's mom Chiharu invents an at-home training program for him. Then it's time for the next battles in the district tournament, with Shu up first.
episodes.title: Get Ready! Crash Course

episodes.synopsis: With another match coming up soon, Valt starts practicing his new special move, the Flash Launch. Wakiya asks Hoji to do something unsportsmanlike.
episodes.title: The Flash Launch! It's Crazy Fast!

episodes.synopsis: With the fourth round of the district tournaments, Valt and Valtryek face off against Hoji and Horusood. Most expect Valt to lose, but not Shu.
episodes.title: A Powerful Opponent! Hyper Horusood!

episodes.synopsis: Valt advances to the semi-finals along with Shu, Orochi and Wakiya. Not content to wait, Wakiya contrives to battle Valt at his family's mansion.
episodes.title: Wyvron in the Way!

episodes.synopsis: After the end of his battle with Wakiya, Valt's friends try to help him regain his love of Beyblade. Meanwhile, Shu gets some news from the doctor.
episodes.title: Get Over It! Trust in Valtryek!

episodes.synopsis: Shu struggles with his medical restrictions and Valt tries to cheer him up, with mixed results. Valt faces Wakiya again, this time in the tournament.
episodes.title: Spryzen's Despair!

episodes.synopsis: Valt's tournament match with Wakiya goes down to the wire as he keeps trying to achieve a burst finish and Shu waits to face Orochi.
episodes.title: Shield Crash Menace!

episodes.synopsis: Shu's match against Orochi continues, with the moves putting increasing strain on Shu's shoulder. Whoever wins will face Valt in the final.
episodes.title: Shu's Test!

episodes.synopsis: Valt and Shu are slated to face each other in the final round of the tournament, but Shu's shoulder hurts and Valt is worried about him.
episodes.title: The Battle We Promised!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Valt and Shu pits Valt's Flash Launch against Shu's new Upper Launch. When Shu takes the lead, Valt has no margin for error.
episodes.title: A Fierce Battle! Valtryek Versus Spryzen!

episodes.synopsis: After the tournament, Valt and his friends follow Shu to Xander's family training ground. To battle Xander, Valt takes on his friend Yugo.
episodes.title: A Group Lesson! Shakadera Special!

episodes.synopsis: Xander and Xcalius battle Valt and Valtryek. Afterwards, Xander leads the group through an intense workout on the obstacle course.
episodes.title: Extreme Xcalius!

episodes.synopsis: The club still has a chance to compete at nationals, and they return to Xander's for team battle training. First up, Daigo faces the mysterious Ukio.
episodes.title: Team Battle! It's Off the Hook!

episodes.synopsis: With Daigo defeated, Rantaro steps up to take on Ukio. He soon discovers that Ukio is holding back, but the team disagrees on what to do.
episodes.title: Roktavor vs Unicrest!

episodes.synopsis: Ken's determination falters as he faces Ukio, but a pep talk from his teammates reminds him that he's not alone. Then it's time for the final battle.
episodes.title: Bring It Together! Chain Launch!

episodes.synopsis: The Beigoma team's battle against the Sword Flames continues, and now it's Valt's turn to face Xander in a three point match.
episodes.title: A Battle of Friendship!

episodes.synopsis: Invitations to the regionals are out, and the Beigomas and their classmates are in. Valt gets his first chance to meet Zac, the idol blader.
episodes.title: Valtryek Awakens!

episodes.synopsis: After the qualifying rounds, Daigo is slated to face Yugo next in the tournament. Doing research on him presents Daigo with a difficult choice.
episodes.title: Lonely Doomscizor!

episodes.synopsis: With the tournament approaching, Rantaro and Hoji find themselves sharing a practice space. When the tournament starts, Rantaro and Valt face off.
episodes.title: Full Strength, For Real!

episodes.synopsis: Zac continues wandering around as the "Masked Blader." After meeting Toko and Nika, he challenges Wakiya to a battle -- an offer Wakiya can't refuse!
episodes.title: The Mysterious Masked Blader!

episodes.synopsis: Daigo decides to quit the Bey Club to make amends for a mistake. Worried about his friend, Valt struggles to concentrate on his match with Orochi.
episodes.title: Let's Do This Thing!

episodes.synopsis: Now that he and Shu have joined the Bey Club, Wakiya invites the other members to his country mansion, where they train in his custom Bey stadium.
episodes.title: Training Camp! The Biting Stadium!

episodes.synopsis: Training camp at Wakiya's mansion continues, complete with cooking duties. Everyone pitches in, but Toko and Nika get a little carried away.
episodes.title: Mountains! Rivers! A Huge Stormy Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: Valt agrees to take part in the opening ceremony for the National Tournament and meets Quon, a Blader friend of Xander's. Then Valtryek goes missing.
episodes.title: Eye on the Prize!

episodes.synopsis: The national tournament kicks off with the Bey Club facing Quon's Ice Blaze team. First, Valt faces his new hero Quon himself.
episodes.title: The Winged Snake! Quetziko!

episodes.synopsis: The Bey Club takes a trip to the Beyblade Museum, and Ken tries to cheer Valt up. Then the tournament resumes with Zac's Superstars up next.
episodes.title: Teachings of a Legend!

episodes.synopsis: Zac throws a giant street party and invites the members of the Bey Club. Valt and Rantaro jump at the chance to try out the life-size Bey stadium.
episodes.title: Cyclone Power!

episodes.synopsis: As the Bey Club faces off against the Sword Flames in the second round of the tournament, Wakiya challenges Valt's leadership as team captain.
episodes.title: Mega Flames! Dual Sabers!

episodes.synopsis: Shu experiments with ways to increase Spryzen's power. Valt and Ken practice together just like old times, but Ken wants to help his new team.
episodes.title: The Beasts Bare Their Fangs!

episodes.synopsis: The team semi-finals pit the Bey Club against the Beasts. Wakiya faces off against Yoga Sakurajima while Valt battles Ben Azuki.
episodes.title: Primal Attack! Beast Betromoth!

episodes.synopsis: Orochi and Gabe face off to decide whose team moves on to the finals. Meanwhile, the Bey Club explains what they do for the video club's documentary.
episodes.title: Rideout Rising!

episodes.synopsis: With the final round of the tournament approaching, the Bey Club listens to Shu's advice and takes a day off from training. But relaxing isn't easy.
episodes.title: Next Stop, Team Finals!

episodes.synopsis: The final round continues. When Lui Shirasagi takes the floor for the Rideouts, the Bey Club team argues over who will face him.
episodes.title: Battle to the Finish! Lost Lúinor

episodes.synopsis: Valt's battle with Lui continues, and the pressure is getting to him. Meanwhile, Shu can't help but recall the last time he faced Lui himself.
episodes.title: Into the Vortex! Lost Spiral!

episodes.synopsis: With the team finals over, Valt turns his mind to the upcoming individual rounds. To gain an edge, he starts working with Bey scientist Naoki Minamo.
episodes.title: All In! Going Solo!

episodes.synopsis: Valt's first opponent in the individual rounds is Naoki, who plans to use the data he collected during their research against him.
episodes.title: Nepstrius' Trap!

episodes.synopsis: The tournament continues, and Shu now faces Jin Aizawa, with Naoki observing eagerly. To win, Shu needs to take a calculated risk.
episodes.title: Jumbo Jormuntor! The Venomous Snake!

episodes.synopsis: Wakiya declares his intention of quitting the Bey Club, and Shu proposes separate training. When the tournament resumes, Valt faces Quon again.
episodes.title: Winged Launch!

episodes.synopsis: Teammates Ken and Ben face off against each other in the individual matches. Out of mutual respect, neither of them holds anything back.
episodes.title: Roar! Battle of the Beasts!

episodes.synopsis: Wakiya and Shu finally face each other again, this time at the national tournament. Only one of them can advance, and it's all on the line.
episodes.title: Spryzen vs. Wyvron

episodes.synopsis: Scheduled to face each other in the third round of the tournament, Valt and Xander train hard with their teammates before stepping into the ring.
episodes.title: Battle for the Top! Valt vs Xander!

episodes.synopsis: Akira's dreams come true when he faces Zac the Sunrise in the third round of the tournament in a star-powered battle to the finish.
episodes.title: Star Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The semi-finals begin with Valt and Zac facing off against each other in a classic underdog versus fan favorite matchup. It's the moment of truth.
episodes.title: Semi-Finals! Spin Versus Speed!

episodes.synopsis: As the semi-finals continue, it's Spin Emperor versus Spin Emperor when Shu and Lui face each other in their first match since the last tournament.
episodes.title: Old Rivals! Lui Versus Shu!

episodes.synopsis: There's just one match left in the national tournament. The Bey Club members train with Valt to help him practice a new move he's been working on.
episodes.title: Overthrowing the King!

episodes.synopsis: Valt's match with Lui comes down to the final rounds. With everything on the line, it's time to find out how far Valt and Valtryek have come.
episodes.title: Final Showdown! Victory Valtryek!
